name: Salt-N-Pepa
notes: Rap group turned R&B-pop crossover; the research windows this entry 1993–1997 only (Very Necessary through Brand New) for Gate 2, and that window is used verbatim. Tempo is "87–103 straight (backbeat 2&4)" with the sourced reading of the En Vogue collaboration at 87, so the mode sits there. The drum deltas are the entry's: "a sampled funk break as the spine" is a lightly-swung kit with a low quantize strength and wide jitter rather than a programmed grid, "the backbeat doubled with a clap on 2&4" is a clap stack with a real offset, and "16th hats with an open hat on the last 8th of the bar" is why `openHat.pos` is pinned to `4&` at a probability well above the parent's. Harmony is "single-chord or two-chord funk vamps over the loop; the sung hook (often guested) supplies all harmonic motion", so the families are one- and two-chord, the major mode leads (the sourced key is F major) and `chordDurationBeats` runs long. "Note density low — the rap carries the rhythm, the hook carries the pitch" is the low melody density, the high `emptyBarBias` and the small motif pitch count. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are the velocity and density numbers, `swing.amount` 0.56 and the bass block; the research marks the percussion garnish (tambourine, cowbell on offbeats) `[LOW-CONF]`, and that mark is why those lanes are authored at low gain rather than as a signature. ⚠ `session.keys` is part-sourced: the entry names `F`, and the remaining values `C`, `Gm`, `Bb`, together with all 4 weights, are INFERRED rather than read from the entry. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 977/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.16 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "single-chord or two-chord funk vamps over the loop; the sung hook (often guested) supplies all harmonic motion. Note density low — the rap carries the rhythm, the hook carries the pitch.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
